title: Investigate why vite-tsconfig-paths silently fails in CI after install-with-cleanup
body: The root cause was not fully identified. The install-with-cleanup action deletes node_modules and reinstalls, but vite-tsconfig-paths should still be able to read tsconfig paths. The fix (explicit resolve.alias) works, but the underlying reason for the plugin's failure in CI was not determined. A future investigation could check if tsconfck has issues with certain node_modules states or if there's a timing issue with the plugin initialization.
rationale: Understanding the root cause would help prevent similar issues in the future and potentially allow removal of the explicit alias workaround if the underlying issue can be fixed.
